100 common Turkmen verbs, conjugated

The 100 most frequent verbs of the Daily Turkmen flashcard deck, in the deck's order: roughly how common each verb is. Each page has the key forms, notes on what changes, the card's example and a table for every verb form the course teaches from A1 to B1, positive, negative and question. The forms below are for ol (he, she, it).

Every ending on one page: the grammar cheat sheet. All 1,000 words of the deck: the word list.
